### Create `apps/api/src/imports/feeder.ts`

```ts
import { IMPORT_RULES, ImportChoice, MEDIA_MAX_BYTES, type ImportImageSkip } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ImportImageRow } from "../media";
import type { ImportDeps } from "./context";
import { endFiles } from "./flows/end";
import { buildPlan, importImageId, refusedPost, type ImportPlan, type PlannedImage } from "./plan";
import type { PreparingImport } from "./repo";
import { scanOf } from "./view";

/**
 * The feeder (3b design, sections 7.4 and 8.2; decisions 17 to 19), a step of import-drive for the one import in preparing
 * confirmed longest ago: one import is fed at a time. The worker is not changed: the feeder puts an imported image into
 * media-uploads/incoming/ through the media module's own receive path only while no upload of anyone's own waits there
 * for the worker, while fewer than IMPORT_RULES.imagesInFlight imported images are processing without a result on the
 * site, and within IMPORT_IMAGES_PER_HOUR counted in the limit store under import-images-site (a store that cannot count
 * feeds nothing), so a person's own upload waits behind at most two imported images.
 *
 * Each round it first finalizes its images still processing and settles each of its rows: ready with a clear check is
 * kept; ready with a match that does not act (no refusal names it) is left out as flagged, never published, and an admin
 * is alerted; failed is left out; one still unchecked, capped or never answered IMPORT_RULES.checkHours after its row was
 * written is left out as not_checked (decision 19, and for a file that never reached the worker the orchestrator's ruling).
 * A row left out is deleted as it settles, in the transaction that counts it, so no settled image changes its count; a
 * refusal stops the import before any post (8.2). Once the cursor has passed every planned image and every row left is
 * kept, the import moves to publishing. Images are imported only while a matcher is (decision 15): with the comparison off,
 * every image not yet fed is left out as not_checked.
 */

/** What a round of the feeder did, for import-drive's report. */
export interface FeedReport {
  fed: number;
  /** Images left out before a row was written (missing_file, unsupported, too_large, not_checked while the matcher is off). */
  skipped: number;
  /** Rows settled as left out, and the flagged among them. */
  leftOut: number;
  flagged: number;
  /** The import stopped on a refused image, or moved to publishing. */
  refused: boolean;
  published: boolean;
}

/** The limit store's key of the site's pace (7.6). */
export const IMAGES_SITE_KEY = "import-images-site";
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;

/** A row's settlement: kept, left out for a reason, or not settled yet. A refused row stops the import before this is asked. */
export function settlementOf(row: ImportImageRow, now: Date): "kept" | ImportImageSkip | null {
  if (row.status === "ready" && row.check === "clear") return "kept";
  // A match that acts is refused (the caller stops the import first); one that does not act is flagged, never published.
  if (row.status === "ready" && row.check === "matched") return "flagged";
  if (row.status === "failed") return "failed";
  if (now.getTime() - row.createdAt.getTime() >= IMPORT_RULES.checkHours * HOUR_MS) return "not_checked";
  return null;
}

/** The import's plan, from the process's cache or built now; null when posts.jsonl cannot be read (the import waits). */
async function planOf(deps: ImportDeps, job: PreparingImport): Promise<ImportPlan | null> {
  const cached = deps.plans.get(job.id);
  if (cached) return cached;
  const scan = scanOf(job);
  const choice = ImportChoice.safeParse(job.choice);
  if (scan === null || !choice.success) {
    deps.log.error({ id: job.id, phase: "feeder" }, "import: a preparing import's scan or choice does not parse");
    return null;
  }
  const built = await buildPlan({
    id: job.id,
    files: deps.files,
    createdAt: job.createdAt,
    fromRef: scan.fromRef,
    choice: choice.data,
    picks: await deps.repo.picks(job.id),
    images: job.images && choice.data.images,
    known: (keys) => deps.social.importedKeys(job.ownerId, keys),
  });
  if (!built.ok) {
    deps.log.error({ id: job.id, phase: "feeder", code: built.code }, "import: posts.jsonl was refused while planning the images");
    return null;
  }
  deps.plans.set(job.id, built.plan);
  deps.log.info({ id: job.id, phase: "feeder", images: built.plan.images.length }, "import: images planned");
  return built.plan;
}

/** Plans of imports that left preparing (a stop, a time limit, an admin's end, the move to publishing) are dropped. */
async function prunePlans(deps: ImportDeps): Promise<void> {
  if (deps.plans.size === 0) return;
  const statuses = await deps.repo.statuses([...deps.plans.keys()]);
  for (const id of [...deps.plans.keys()]) if (statuses.get(id) !== "preparing") deps.plans.delete(id);
}

/** 8.2: the first refusal stops the import, its other rows and its work folder go, and nothing of it was published. */
async function stopOnRefusal(deps: ImportDeps, job: PreparingImport, plan: ImportPlan, refusedId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const image: PlannedImage | undefined = plan.images.find((planned) => importImageId(job.seed, planned.ref, planned.position) === refusedId);
  // The post's day and first words are read from the work line before the folder goes; a line that cannot be read again
  // leaves both unset, and the screen then names no post.
  const post = image === undefined ? null : await refusedPost(deps.files, job.id, image);
  const gone = await deps.repo.stopRefused(job.id, post, (tx) => deps.media.deleteImportLeftovers(tx, job.id));
  if (gone === null) return false;
  deps.plans.delete(job.id);
  await deps.media.releaseFiles(gone);
  await endFiles(deps, job.id);
  deps.log.warn({ id: job.id, phase: "stopped", reason: "refused_image", deleted: gone.length }, "import: stopped by a refused image");
  return true;
}

/** One round of the feeder at `now`; null when no import prepares. */
export async function feedRound(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date): Promise<FeedReport | null> {
  await prunePlans(deps);
  const job = await deps.repo.preparing();
  if (!job) return null;
  const report: FeedReport = { fed: 0, skipped: 0, leftOut: 0, flagged: 0, refused: false, published: false };
  const plan = await planOf(deps, job);
  if (plan === null) return report;

  // Settling: finalize what the worker answered, then judge every row on no post.
  const rows = await deps.media.settleRows(job.id);
  const refused = rows.find((row) => row.refused);
  if (refused) {
    report.refused = await stopOnRefusal(deps, job, plan, refused.id);
    return report;
  }
  let kept = 0;
  let waiting = 0;
  const leftOut = new Map<string, ImportImageSkip>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const settled = settlementOf(row, now);
    if (settled === "kept") kept++;
    else if (settled === null) waiting++;
    else leftOut.set(row.id, settled);
  }
  if (leftOut.size > 0 || kept > job.imagesKept) {
    const gone = await deps.repo.settle(job.id, kept, leftOut, (tx, ids) => deps.media.deleteImportLeftovers(tx, job.id, ids));
    if (gone === null) return report;
    await deps.media.releaseFiles(gone);
    report.leftOut = gone.length;
    report.flagged = gone.filter((id) => leftOut.get(id) === "flagged").length;
    waiting += leftOut.size - gone.length;
    // After the commit, to every staff account: counts and a time, never an image (8.1).
    if (report.flagged > 0) await deps.moderation.imagesFlagged({ importId: job.id, count: report.flagged, at: now });
  }

  let cursor = job.imageCursor;
  // Decision 15: no image is fed while no matcher checks it. What was not fed yet is left out, and the import goes on.
  if (!deps.media.matching && cursor < plan.images.length) {
    const rest = plan.images.length - cursor;
    if (!(await deps.repo.skipImages(job.id, cursor, rest, "not_checked"))) return report;
    report.skipped += rest;
    cursor += rest;
  }

  while (cursor < plan.images.length) {
    if (await deps.media.ownUploadWaiting()) break;
    if ((await deps.media.importedInFlight()) >= IMPORT_RULES.imagesInFlight) break;
    if (!(await deps.media.hasRoom())) break;
    const image = plan.images[cursor]!;
    const opened = await deps.files.openWork(deps.files.work.media(job.id, image.file), MEDIA_MAX_BYTES);
    if (!opened.ok) {
      // The importer's output is hostile: a symlink, a folder that is a link, a file of another device or a swapped one is
      // never read, and is left out as missing, as the intake counts it.
      deps.log.warn({ id: job.id, phase: "feeder", code: opened.code }, "import: an image's work file was refused (missing_file)");
      if (!(await deps.repo.skipImages(job.id, cursor, 1, "missing_file"))) return report;
      report.skipped++;
      cursor++;
      continue;
    }
    let receipt: Awaited<ReturnType<ImportDeps["media"]["receive"]>>;
    try {
      // The site's pace, counted only for an image the worker will be given; a store that cannot count feeds nothing.
      let hit: { count: number };
      try {
        hit = await deps.limits.hit(IMAGES_SITE_KEY, HOUR_MS);
      } catch {
        deps.log.warn({ id: job.id, phase: "feeder" }, "import: the limit store could not count the site's pace; nothing is fed");
        break;
      }
      if (hit.count > deps.settings.imagesPerHour) break;
      const from = cursor;
      receipt = await deps.media.receive({
        id: importImageId(job.seed, image.ref, image.position),
        ownerId: job.ownerId,
        file: opened.file,
        now,
        importJob: { id: job.id, claim: (tx) => deps.repo.claimImage(tx, job.id, job.ownerId, from) },
      });
    } finally {
      await opened.file.handle.close();
    }
    if (receipt === "fed") {
      report.fed++;
      cursor++;
      continue;
    }
    // A row of that id exists already and is settled in a later round, as a fed one is.
    if (receipt === "already") waiting++;
    // The import moved on, or its owner's suspension runs: nothing was written, and the import waits for the next round.
    if (receipt === "stopped" || receipt === "suspended") return report;
    // A sniff or a size the media module refuses is never retried; an id fed before is passed over without a count of its own.
    const reason = receipt === "already" ? null : receipt;
    if (!(await deps.repo.skipImages(job.id, cursor, 1, reason))) return report;
    if (reason !== null) report.skipped++;
    cursor++;
  }

  // Every planned image handed over and every row left kept: the import publishes (7.5 step 4). An image fed in this round
  // has not settled yet, so its round never publishes.
  if (cursor >= plan.images.length && waiting === 0 && report.fed === 0 && (await deps.repo.toPublishing(job.id, cursor, kept))) {
    deps.plans.delete(job.id);
    report.published = true;
    deps.log.info({ id: job.id, phase: "publishing", kept }, "import: images settled; publishing");
  }
  return report;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/imports/flows/confirm.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { ConfirmImportRequest, IMPORT_RULES, type ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { enforceImportLimit, ImportError, type ImportDeps } from "../context";
import { chosenTotals } from "../plan";
import { importView, scanOf } from "../view";

/**
 * POST /api/imports/:id/confirm (3b design, sections 4.5 step 1, 8.5, 9.2 and 9.5): the person's choice and statement,
 * counted in import-act. A body without the statement is statement_required (decision 14), any other bad body
 * invalid_request; a suspended account is refused (8.5: a confirmation starts writes), read through the profile store; the
 * import must be ready; `from` and `to` must lie within the scan's months; a choice that holds no post is nothing_chosen.
 * The totals are counted as the app counts them under the choice, from the month table and the picks, before the
 * confirmation cuts the table, and kept as the scan's member `chosen` (the orchestrator's ruling). One UPDATE then writes
 * the state, the choice, the statement's time, confirmed_at, a fresh seed of IMPORT_RULES.seedBytes and the cut scan: the
 * import prepares when it and the choice bring images and the choice holds at least one to feed, and publishes at once
 * otherwise. The picks stay until the import ends; the feeder and the publisher read them.
 */

/** Whether a refused body would be taken but for its statement: then the person did not tick it. */
function lacksStatement(body: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof body !== "object" || body === null || Array.isArray(body)) return false;
  if ((body as { statement?: unknown }).statement === true) return false;
  return ConfirmImportRequest.safeParse({ ...body, statement: true }).success;
}

export async function confirmImport(deps: ImportDeps, ownerId: string, id: string, body: unknown): Promise<ImportView> {
  const parsed = ConfirmImportRequest.safeParse(body);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new ImportError(lacksStatement(body) ? "statement_required" : "invalid_request");
  await enforceImportLimit(deps, "import-act", ownerId);
  const row = await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId);
  if (!row) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  // 8.5: the writes a confirmation starts are judged by 3e's predicate where they are written; the confirmation itself is
  // refused while the suspension runs, read as the badge's start reads it.
  if (await deps.profiles.suspended(ownerId)) throw new ImportError("account_suspended");
  const scan = scanOf(row);
  if (row.status !== "ready" || scan === null) throw new ImportError("wrong_state");
  const { choice } = parsed.data;
  // 9.5: a range outside the months the archive has is not a choice the preview offered.
  const within = (month: string | null) => month === null || (scan.first !== null && scan.last !== null && month >= scan.first && month <= scan.last);
  if (!within(choice.from) || !within(choice.to)) throw new ImportError("invalid_request");
  const images = row.images && choice.images;
  const chosen = chosenTotals(scan, await deps.repo.picks(id), choice, images);
  if (chosen.posts === 0) throw new ImportError("nothing_chosen");
  const status = images && chosen.images > 0 ? "preparing" : "publishing";
  const seed = randomBytes(IMPORT_RULES.seedBytes);
  if (!(await deps.repo.confirm({ id, ownerId, status, choice, seed, chosen }))) throw new ImportError("wrong_state");
  deps.log.info({ id, phase: status, posts: chosen.posts, images: chosen.images }, "import: confirmed");
  const confirmed = await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId);
  if (!confirmed) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  return importView(deps, confirmed);
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/imports/plan.ts`

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { IMPORT_MARKS, IMPORT_RULES, MEDIA_MAX_BYTES, type ImportChoice, type ImportScanFacts, type ImportedPost } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { LINE_MAX_BYTES, POSTS_MAX_BYTES, POSTS_MAX_LINES, parsePostLine, readLineAt, readLines, type WorkFileRefusal } from "@korbat/import-protocol";
import type { ImportFiles } from "./files";
import { latestDate, marksOf, readableLine } from "./intake";
import type { PickRow } from "./repo";

/**
 * What a confirmed import publishes and prepares (3b design, sections 4.5, 6.5 and 7.4), in one place each: the derived
 * ids of its posts and images, the rule that keeps a line, the totals a choice holds, and the plan of the images the feeder
 * hands to the media pipeline. Task 5's feeder and confirmation use them; Task 6's publisher uses the same rule, ids and
 * plan, so a post and its images agree on what was chosen. Nothing here writes, and nothing of a line's text is kept but
 * the first words of a refused image's post, which the refusal stores (8.2).
 */

/**
 * 6.5's uuidFrom: the first 16 bytes of a digest as a UUID of version 4, its version and variant bits set and written in
 * lowercase hex, so isMediaId and every uuid column take it. Without the seed nobody can predict one.
 */
export function uuidFrom(digest: Uint8Array): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(digest.subarray(0, 16));
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const hex = bytes.toString("hex");
  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20, 32)}`;
}

/** A post's id: uuidFrom(SHA-256(seed || "post:" || ref)). A parent's id is computed, never looked up. */
export const importPostId = (seed: Uint8Array, ref: number): string => uuidFrom(createHash("sha256").update(seed).update(`post:${ref}`).digest());

/** An image's id: uuidFrom(SHA-256(seed || "image:" || ref || ":" || position)), its position in the line's media. */
export const importImageId = (seed: Uint8Array, ref: number, position: number): string => uuidFrom(createHash("sha256").update(seed).update(`image:${ref}:${position}`).digest());

const bit = (mark: (typeof IMPORT_MARKS)[number]): number => 1 << IMPORT_MARKS.indexOf(mark);

/** Whether a choice keeps a line of these marks (IMPORT_MARKS' bits): replies, long posts, warnings and protected posts each as chosen. */
export function marksPass(marks: number, choice: ImportChoice): boolean {
  if (marks & bit("reply") && !choice.replies) return false;
  if (marks & bit("long") && choice.long !== "shorten") return false;
  if (marks & bit("warning") && !choice.warnings) return false;
  if (marks & bit("protected") && !choice.protected) return false;
  return true;
}

/** Whether a month (YYYY-MM) is within the choice's range, either end open when null. */
export const monthInChoice = (month: string, choice: Pick<ImportChoice, "from" | "to">): boolean =>
  (choice.from === null || month >= choice.from) && (choice.to === null || month <= choice.to);

/** Why a line is not published: before the lowest ref a new account may publish, already imported, or the choice's. */
export type LineVerdict = { kept: true } | { kept: false; reason: "new_account_cap" | "already_imported" | "month" | "marks" | "left_out" };

/** What a line is judged by once the import is confirmed. */
export interface KeptLineRule {
  /** scan.fromRef: the lowest ref that may be published (decision 21). */
  fromRef: number;
  choice: ImportChoice;
  /** The person's picks, by ref (4.4). */
  picks: ReadonlyMap<number, PickRow>;
  /** The keys the account's posts carry now, asked again after the intake (7.5 step 2). */
  known: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

/**
 * The rule that keeps a line (6.5): its ref is at least fromRef, the account carries no post of its key, its month is
 * within the choice's range, its marks pass the choice, and its pick does not leave it out. The line must be one the
 * intake's rule reads (readableLine) for this to be asked.
 */
export function keptLine(post: Pick<ImportedPost, "ref" | "key" | "at" | "kind" | "text" | "warning" | "protected">, rule: KeptLineRule): LineVerdict {
  if (post.ref < rule.fromRef) return { kept: false, reason: "new_account_cap" };
  if (rule.known.has(post.key)) return { kept: false, reason: "already_imported" };
  if (!monthInChoice(post.at.slice(0, 7), rule.choice)) return { kept: false, reason: "month" };
  if (!marksPass(marksOf(post), rule.choice)) return { kept: false, reason: "marks" };
  if (rule.picks.get(post.ref)?.leftOut) return { kept: false, reason: "left_out" };
  return { kept: true };
}

/**
 * The description an image is attached with (decision 20): its source's, or the one the person wrote in the preview
 * (`alts[i]` is media[i]'s); null when it has neither, and then it is neither fed nor attached (no_description).
 */
export function imageAlt(media: ImportedPost["media"][number], pick: PickRow | undefined, position: number): string | null {
  return media.alt ?? pick?.alts?.[position] ?? null;
}

/**
 * The posts and images a choice holds (the orchestrator's ruling for Task 5), counted as the app counts them under the
 * choice (4.4): from the scan's month table, whose groups are [marks, posts, images, images without a source's
 * description] of the offered lines, and the picks' facts ([posts left out, their described images, descriptions given in
 * posts not left out], 9.3), over the months and marks the choice keeps. Images count only while the import and the
 * choice both bring them.
 */
export function chosenTotals(scan: Pick<ImportScanFacts, "months">, picks: readonly PickRow[], choice: ImportChoice, images: boolean): { posts: number; images: number } {
  let posts = 0;
  let kept = 0;
  for (const { month, groups } of scan.months) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, count, withImages, undescribed] of groups) {
      if (!marksPass(marks, choice)) continue;
      posts += count;
      kept += withImages - undescribed;
    }
  }
  for (const pick of picks) {
    if (!monthInChoice(pick.month, choice) || !marksPass(pick.marks, choice)) continue;
    if (pick.leftOut) {
      posts -= 1;
      kept -= pick.described;
    } else {
      kept += (pick.alts ?? []).filter((alt) => alt !== null).length;
    }
  }
  return { posts: Math.max(0, posts), images: images ? Math.max(0, kept) : 0 };
}

/** One image the feeder hands to the media pipeline: the line, its place among the line's media, the file and its description. */
export interface PlannedImage {
  ref: number;
  position: number;
  file: string;
  alt: string;
  /** The line's byte offset in posts.jsonl, from which a refusal reads the post's day and first words (8.2). */
  offset: number;
}

/** The images of a confirmed import in feeding order: oldest line first, then by position. image_cursor counts into it. */
export interface ImportPlan {
  images: PlannedImage[];
}

export interface PlanInput {
  id: string;
  files: Pick<ImportFiles, "openWork" | "work">;
  /** When the import was created, from which the latest date a line may carry counts (5.4). */
  createdAt: Date;
  fromRef: number;
  choice: ImportChoice;
  picks: readonly PickRow[];
  /** The import brings images (import_jobs.images) and the choice does too. */
  images: boolean;
  /** The social module's read of the keys the account's posts carry, at most a thousand a call. */
  known: (keys: readonly string[]) => Promise<ReadonlySet<string>>;
  /** Tests only: the newest-first cap, as the intake's caps. */
  maxImages?: number;
}

/** A line with images, as the plan reads it the first time. */
interface MediaLine {
  post: ImportedPost;
  offset: number;
}

/**
 * The plan (7.4), built once a process for each import that prepares, since the preview's pages were cut at the
 * confirmation: posts.jsonl is read once through openWorkFile by the intake's own rule, the keys of its lines with images
 * are asked again, and the images kept are chosen exactly as the intake counted them, the newest lines first up to
 * IMPORT_RULES.maxImages, each line's present files in order (a file openWorkFile refuses was counted missing_file then,
 * and is skipped here) and only as long as the cap has room, so no more than the cap's files are opened. A kept line's
 * images with a description are planned, in ref and position order. At most maxImages entries are held, a few hundred
 * kilobytes; reading a posts.jsonl of 1 GiB takes the intake's time, once.
 */
export async function buildPlan(input: PlanInput): Promise<{ ok: true; plan: ImportPlan } | { ok: false; code: WorkFileRefusal | "invalid" }> {
  if (!input.images) return { ok: true, plan: { images: [] } };
  const { files, id } = input;
  const opened = await files.openWork(files.work.posts(id), POSTS_MAX_BYTES);
  if (!opened.ok) return { ok: false, code: opened.code };
  const latest = latestDate(input.createdAt);
  const lines: MediaLine[] = [];
  try {
    let index = 0;
    for await (const line of readLines(opened.file.handle, { maxLines: POSTS_MAX_LINES, maxBytes: POSTS_MAX_BYTES, lineMaxBytes: LINE_MAX_BYTES })) {
      const post = readableLine(line.text, index++, latest);
      if (post !== null && post.ref >= input.fromRef && post.media.length > 0) lines.push({ post, offset: line.offset });
    }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: "error" };
  } finally {
    await opened.file.handle.close();
  }

  const known = new Set<string>();
  for (let from = 0; from < lines.length; from += IMPORT_RULES.keyBatch) {
    for (const key of await input.known(lines.slice(from, from + IMPORT_RULES.keyBatch).map(({ post }) => post.key))) known.add(key);
  }
  const picks = new Map(input.picks.map((pick) => [pick.ref, pick]));
  const rule: KeptLineRule = { fromRef: input.fromRef, choice: input.choice, picks, known };
  const cap = input.maxImages ?? IMPORT_RULES.maxImages;

  const planned: PlannedImage[] = [];
  let counted = 0;
  // Newest first, as the intake capped them: an offered line's present images count against the cap whatever the choice.
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0 && counted < cap; i--) {
    const { post, offset } = lines[i]!;
    if (known.has(post.key)) continue;
    const present: number[] = [];
    for (const [position, media] of post.media.entries()) {
      if (counted + present.length >= cap) break;
      const image = await files.openWork(files.work.media(id, media.file), MEDIA_MAX_BYTES);
      if (!image.ok) continue;
      await image.file.handle.close();
      present.push(position);
    }
    counted += present.length;
    if (!keptLine(post, rule).kept) continue;
    for (const position of present) {
      const alt = imageAlt(post.media[position]!, picks.get(post.ref), position);
      if (alt !== null) planned.push({ ref: post.ref, position, file: post.media[position]!.file, alt, offset });
    }
  }
  planned.sort((a, b) => a.ref - b.ref || a.position - b.position);
  return { ok: true, plan: { images: planned } };
}

/**
 * A refused image's post, as the import's row keeps it (8.2): its archive's day and its first words, at most
 * IMPORT_RULES.refusedWordsMax code points, cut at the last space within them when the text is longer, its line breaks
 * read as spaces. Read from the work line before the work folder goes; null when the line cannot be read again.
 */
export async function refusedPost(files: Pick<ImportFiles, "openWork" | "work">, id: string, image: Pick<PlannedImage, "ref" | "offset">): Promise<{ day: string; words: string } | null> {
  const opened = await files.openWork(files.work.posts(id), POSTS_MAX_BYTES);
  if (!opened.ok) return null;
  try {
    const text = await readLineAt(opened.file.handle, image.offset, LINE_MAX_BYTES);
    const post = text === null ? null : parsePostLine(text);
    if (post === null || post.ref !== image.ref) return null;
    return { day: post.at.slice(0, 10), words: firstWords(post.text) };
  } finally {
    await opened.file.handle.close();
  }
}

/** A run of spaces, tabs and line breaks (an imported text holds no other control character, 5.3), built without escapes. */
const SPACES = new RegExp(`[ ${String.fromCharCode(9, 10, 13)}]+`, "g");

/** The first words of a text, at most IMPORT_RULES.refusedWordsMax code points, cut at a space where it is longer. */
export function firstWords(text: string): string {
  const points = Array.from(text.replace(SPACES, " ").trim());
  if (points.length <= IMPORT_RULES.refusedWordsMax) return points.join("");
  const head = points.slice(0, IMPORT_RULES.refusedWordsMax);
  const space = head.lastIndexOf(" ");
  return (space > 0 ? head.slice(0, space) : head).join("").trim();
}
```

```sql
-- 2. import_jobs_insert, replaced: 0043's text, byte for byte, with one line more: a new import has left out no image, so

-- function's owner, its grants and its trigger.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_insert"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles a WHERE a.id = NEW.owner_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_found';
  END IF;
  NEW.status := 'uploading';
  NEW.created_at := clock_timestamp();
  NEW.received_bytes := 0;
  NEW.uploaded_at := NULL;
  NEW.scanned_at := NULL;
  NEW.confirmed_at := NULL;
  NEW.ended_at := NULL;
  NEW.failure := NULL;
  NEW.stop_reason := NULL;
  NEW.staff_ended_at := NULL;
  NEW.staff_rule_id := NULL;
  NEW.refused_at_original := NULL;
  NEW.refused_words := NULL;
  NEW.scan := NULL;
  NEW.choice := NULL;
  NEW.stated_at := NULL;
  NEW.seed := NULL;
  NEW.post_cursor := 0;
  NEW.image_cursor := 0;
  NEW.posts_published := 0;
  NEW.images_kept := 0;
  NEW.images_left_out := 0;
  NEW.images_left_out_by := '{}'::jsonb;
  NEW.posts_removed := 0;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 3. import_jobs_guard, replaced: 0043's text, byte for byte, with two rules more at its end, for images_left_out_by:
--   - each count is a whole number, none smaller than it was, and no reason it held goes (a reason's count only grows,
--     as images_left_out does);
--   - on every update its counts sum to images_left_out: every image left out is counted under one reason, so a writer
--     that adds to images_left_out names the reason in the same statement.
--   Both are asked only of an object: anything else is the CHECK import_jobs_left_out_by's to refuse, after this trigger.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."import_jobs_guard"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  was text;
  goes text;
  moved boolean;
  confirming boolean;
BEGIN
  IF current_user = 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  was := OLD.status::text;
  goes := NEW.status::text;
  moved := goes <> was;
  confirming := moved AND was = 'ready' AND goes IN ('preparing', 'publishing');
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_id OR NEW.source::text IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source::text
     OR NEW.declared_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.declared_bytes OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF moved AND (was, goes) NOT IN (('uploading', 'scanning'), ('uploading', 'failed'), ('uploading', 'cancelled'), ('uploading', 'expired'),
                                   ('scanning', 'ready'), ('scanning', 'failed'), ('scanning', 'cancelled'),
                                   ('ready', 'preparing'), ('ready', 'publishing'), ('ready', 'cancelled'), ('ready', 'expired'),
                                   ('preparing', 'publishing'), ('preparing', 'stopped'),
                                   ('publishing', 'done'), ('publishing', 'stopped'),
                                   ('done', 'undoing'), ('stopped', 'undoing'), ('undoing', 'undone')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF moved AND was = 'stopped' AND goes = 'undoing' AND NEW.posts_published <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.ended_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ended_at AND NOT (moved AND goes IN ('done', 'stopped', 'undone', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')))
     OR (moved AND goes IN ('done', 'stopped', 'undone', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired') AND NEW.ended_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.uploaded_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.uploaded_at AND NOT (moved AND goes = 'scanning'))
     OR (moved AND goes = 'scanning' AND (NEW.uploaded_at IS NULL OR NEW.received_bytes <> NEW.declared_bytes)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.scanned_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scanned_at AND NOT (moved AND was = 'scanning'))
     OR (moved AND was = 'scanning' AND NEW.scanned_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.scan IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scan AND NOT (moved AND (goes = 'ready' OR was = 'ready')))
     OR (moved AND goes = 'ready' AND NEW.scan IS NULL)
     OR (moved AND was = 'ready' AND (NEW.scan -> 'months' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR NEW.scan -> 'samples' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
                                      OR NEW.scan -> 'pages' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR NEW.scan #> '{skipped,not_public}' IS NOT NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF ((NEW.choice IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.choice OR NEW.stated_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.stated_at OR NEW.confirmed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmed_at) AND NOT confirming)
     OR (NEW.seed IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seed AND NOT confirming AND NEW.seed IS NOT NULL)
     OR (confirming AND (NEW.choice IS NULL OR NEW.stated_at IS NULL OR NEW.confirmed_at IS NULL OR NEW.seed IS NULL))
     OR (moved AND goes IN ('done', 'stopped') AND NEW.seed IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.failure IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.failure AND NOT (moved AND goes = 'failed'))
     OR (NEW.stop_reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.stop_reason AND NOT (moved AND goes = 'stopped')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF ((NEW.staff_ended_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staff_ended_at OR NEW.staff_rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staff_rule_id)
      AND NOT (moved AND goes IN ('stopped', 'undoing') AND OLD.staff_ended_at IS NULL AND OLD.staff_rule_id IS NULL))
     OR (moved AND goes = 'stopped' AND (NEW.stop_reason IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'by_staff') <> (NEW.staff_ended_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.refused_at_original IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refused_at_original OR NEW.refused_words IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refused_words)
     AND NOT (moved AND goes = 'stopped' AND NEW.stop_reason IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'refused_image') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.received_bytes < OLD.received_bytes OR NEW.post_cursor < OLD.post_cursor OR NEW.image_cursor < OLD.image_cursor
     OR NEW.posts_published < OLD.posts_published OR NEW.images_kept < OLD.images_kept OR NEW.images_left_out < OLD.images_left_out
     OR NEW.posts_removed < OLD.posts_removed THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(NEW.images_left_out_by) = 'object' THEN
    IF NEW.images_left_out_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.images_left_out_by
       AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(NEW.images_left_out_by) e
                     WHERE CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.value) <> 'number' THEN true
                                ELSE (e.value)::numeric <> trunc((e.value)::numeric)
                                     OR (e.value)::numeric < coalesce((OLD.images_left_out_by ->> e.key)::numeric, 0) END)
            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(OLD.images_left_out_by) o WHERE NOT (NEW.images_left_out_by ? o.key))) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    IF (SELECT coalesce(sum((e.value)::numeric), 0) FROM jsonb_each(NEW.images_left_out_by) e) <> NEW.images_left_out THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'import_column' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
```

```json
          ],

          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },

        }

          ],
          "using": "true",
          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },

        },

        },

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\" <@ array['dsa18_1', 'dsa18_2', 'tco14_5', 'voluntary']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent_kinds": {

        },

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" in ('not_illegal', 'illegal', 'no_assessment', 'other')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_opened_via": {

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" in ('system', 'cli')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_seal": {

          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" = 'system') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"seal_action_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_closed": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_closed",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'owed') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"closed_at\" is null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_declined": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_declined",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'declined') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" <> 'sent' or (\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_at\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"authority\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"channel\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" is not null and cardinality(\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\") > 0 and \"authority_notifications\".\"not_kept_version\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answered": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answered",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" is null or \"authority_notifications\".\"answered_at\" is not null"
        },
        "authority_notifications_texts": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_texts",
          "value": "char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"check_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"state_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"checked_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"authority\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"channel\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"receipt\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"own_reference\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"their_reference\") <= 200"
        }
```
