```ts
import { RETENTION, type AlertFacts, type ReleaseNoticeView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MailRefused, type MailMessage, type NoticeUpdateLine } from "../../mail/mailer";
import type { DecisionMailSubject } from "../../mail/templates";
import type { AuthDeps } from "../context";
import { decrypt, encrypt, randomToken, safeEqual } from "../crypto";
import { emailHash } from "../identifiers";
import { HOUR } from "../limits";
import { noticeTime } from "./notify";

/**
 * The auth module's side of reports and notices (3c design, section 5): a signed-out notifier's name and address, which
 * live here, encrypted, where the API's role cannot reach them, and every mail of the moderation module, which never
 * sees an address or a mail token. The moderation module names a contact by an id it chose, names an account by its id,
 * and passes typed messages: no caller passes free text, and this module builds every link itself.
 */

const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

/** An address that is not confirmed gets at most one receipt in this long; further ones are folded into the next daily mail. */
export const RECEIPT_CAP_MS = DAY;

/** The receipt of a report or a notice: its reference, when it was received, and the korbat links it named, in the order named. */
export interface NoticeReceivedMessage {
  template: "notice_received";
  ref: string;
  receivedAt: Date;
  items: readonly string[];
}

/** The daily update of decisions on the reports an account sent: its lines, as the moderation module composed them. */
export interface AccountUpdateMessage {
  template: "notice_update";
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons to the author of what a decision restricts or lifts: the subject by its key, and the
 * statement's paragraphs exactly as they were rendered for the author's screen. 3e (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6):
 * a suspension or termination taken at once, and the lift of one (or its end when a reversal broke its basis), are
 * mailed under a subject and a lead of their own, with the same paragraphs; the moderation module picks the template
 * (mailTemplateOf). Times are instants, printed here as the notices print them.
 */
export type DecisionMessage =
  | { template: "moderation_decision"; subject: DecisionMailSubject; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: an announced measure, with its days (null for a termination), the reply window in hours and the earliest start.
  | { template: "suspension_announced"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; window: number; earliestStart: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_started_at_once"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; endsAt: string | null; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: the answer to the person's reply, which kept the measure in force or reversed it.
  | { template: "reply_answered"; outcome: "kept" | "reversed"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "lifted" | "basis"; period: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: a withdrawal signed `replaced`, with the withdrawn decision's time and whether the person had replied to it.
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "replaced"; decidedAt: string; replied: boolean; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 5: a warning about the account's reports; a restriction of them, with its days and its end.
  | { template: "reporting_warned"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "reporting_restricted"; days: number; endsAt: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3f Task 3 (design, W.5): an order's notice, a reinstatement after one, and the authority's words added to a notice
  // already told. Each says only that a notice is there or has grown: its paragraphs are not mailed, and are empty.
  | { template: "order_notice" | "order_reinstated_notice" | "order_notice_added"; paragraphs: readonly string[] };

/** The templates of a decision's statement mail: a stop of the address never holds one back. */
const DECISION_TEMPLATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "moderation_decision",
  "suspension_announced",
  "suspension_started_at_once",
  "reply_answered",
  "suspension_lifted",
  "reporting_warned",
  "reporting_restricted",
  "order_notice",
  "order_reinstated_notice",
  "order_notice_added",
]);

/** Whether an account's message is a decision's statement. */
const isDecisionMessage = (message: { template: string }): message is DecisionMessage => DECISION_TEMPLATES.has(message.template);

/** What the statement's paragraphs are joined with in a mail's data: one paragraph per line. */
const LINE_BREAK = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A decision's message as its template's flat data: one data value for the statement, one paragraph per line, exactly as it was rendered. */
function decisionData(message: DecisionMessage): Record<string, string> {
  const statement = message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK);
  switch (message.template) {
    case "moderation_decision":
      return { subject: message.subject, statement };
    case "suspension_announced":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, window: String(message.window), earliestStart: noticeTime(new Date(message.earliestStart)), ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }) };
    case "suspension_started_at_once":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }), ...(message.endsAt === null ? {} : { endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) }) };
    case "reply_answered":
      return { outcome: message.outcome, statement };
    case "suspension_lifted":
      return message.why === "replaced"
        ? { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, decidedAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.decidedAt)), replied: String(message.replied), statement }
        : { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, period: message.period, statement };
    case "reporting_warned":
      return { statement };
    case "reporting_restricted":
      return { statement, days: String(message.days), endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) };
    case "order_notice":
    case "order_reinstated_notice":
    case "order_notice_added":
      // A fixed body: nothing of the notice goes by mail.
      return {};
  }
}

/** What may be sent to a signed-out notifier's contact by itself: the receipt. Its updates go by address, through mailNotifierUpdates. */
export type NotifierMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage;
/**
 * 3d (design, sections 7.1 and 7.15; W.8): the notice that korbat lost the files of an image of the account's post while
 * they were kept apart in the quarantine, with the post's creation time. No stop of the address holds it back: it is no
 * mail about the account's reports.
 */
export interface ImageLostMessage {
  template: "image_lost";
  postCreatedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2 and 7.15; W.6 and W.8): the author's notice of a release of sealed images of their
 * posts, with the view its paragraphs are rendered from: the ground, the times, the posts' times and the counts, never an
 * authority, a reference or an assessment. No stop of the address holds it back: it is about the account's own posts.
 */
export interface ReleaseNoticeMessage {
  template: "release_notice";
  view: ReleaseNoticeView;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 7.12, 7.15; W.5 and W.8): the uploader's two notices of a refused upload, each with the
 * notice's paragraphs as rendered for the app's screen (uploadNoticeParagraphs): `upload_refused` after the refusal's
 * commit, and `upload_hold_lifted` once a hold ended as no_report has passed its delay, with the paragraph of that end. No
 * stop of the address holds either back: each is about the account's own upload.
 */
export interface UploadNoticeMessage {
  template: "upload_refused" | "upload_hold_lifted";
  paragraphs: readonly string[];
}

/** What may be sent to an account: the receipt and the daily update of its reports, the statement of a decision about it, and (3d) the notices of a lost image, of a release and of a refused upload. */
export type AccountMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage | AccountUpdateMessage | DecisionMessage | ImageLostMessage | ReleaseNoticeMessage | UploadNoticeMessage;

/** One contact's share of the daily update: the lines of its notice, and its receipt when the 24-hour cap folded it. */
export interface NotifierUpdatePart {
  contactId: string;
  /** The reference of the contact's notice. */
  ref: string;
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
  receipt?: { ref: string; receivedAt: Date; items: readonly string[] };
}

/** What became of one contact's share: as a mail's result, or "unavailable" when the relay could not take that address's mail or the contact could not be read. */
export type NotifierUpdateResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused" | "unavailable";

/**
 * The staff alerts: counts, times and a staff account's public handle, never a link or content. The urgent lane's alert;
 * the cases that wait longer than their lane's response time, and those that hold a measure taken while deciding for
 * more than a day; the staff account that confirmed many decisions in a short time; the one that reached its daily case
 * limit; every reveal of who sent a report, with the day's count; and every decision that lifted the protection of
 * images reported as child sexual abuse material.
 */
export type StaffMessage =
  | StaffAlertMessage
  // 3f's review (people4): `phones`, whether the phone alerts are on (NOTIFY), so the mail never says a push went to a
  // phone when nothing publishes one, and says instead that it is the only alert.
  // 3d Task 7 (W.7): `heldUploads`, the held uploads that wait for an admin or hold an unanswered objection, which the
  // mail prints as a second sentence when it is above zero; `count` and `oldest` include them.
  // 3d review L8: `count` is the lane's cases alone and `oldest` the oldest case's, null when no case waits and the alert
  // is for held uploads alone.
  | { template: "moderation_urgent"; count: number; oldest: Date | null; phones: boolean; heldUploads?: number }
  | { template: "moderation_waiting"; lanes: readonly { lane: 0 | 1 | 2; count: number; oldest: Date }[]; interim: number; replies?: { count: number; oldest: Date } | null; phones: boolean }
  | { template: "moderation_burst"; handle: string; count: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reads"; handle: string; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reveal"; handle: string; at: Date; count: number; limit: number }
  // 3d Task 7 (7.11 step 6, W.8): `matched` on a case whose finding came from a match: the variant that says the images
  // stay closed to staff. It carries no reason: the reason is on the decision, where the console shows it.
  | { template: "moderation_csam_lifted"; handle: string; at: Date; what: "unsealed" | "dismissed"; matched?: true };

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 7.2, 7.19 and 18, W.4): the staff alerts whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick
 * mails from a row of alert_outbox: the row's facts, counts and times only, and nothing else. Later tasks of 3f add their
 * kinds here as they first write them.
 */
export type StaffAlertKind =
  | "contact_mail"
  | "contact_mail_escalated"
  | "order_due"
  | "mailbox_unreachable"
  | "alert_channel_down"
  | "order_opened"
  | "order_corrected"
  | "order_unverified"
  // Task 3: an order given effect, an order's measure lifted, and a held notice about to be released.
  | "order_effected"
  | "order_reinstated"
  | "hold_ending"
  // Task 6: the copy of the audit log's tail is overdue, and someone who did not take the last copy took one.
  | "copy_overdue"
  | "copy_taken"
  // Task 5's two daily kinds, joined in 3f's review: a report to an authority owed, a hand-over's copy not destroyed.
  | "report_owed"
  | "handover_undestroyed"
  // 3d Task 1: a move of sealed files that is due, which alert_steps() writes daily, and files the quarantine's record
  // says are lost, which staff.js quarantine-record writes with its record.
  | "quarantine_due"
  | "quarantine_lost"
  // 3d Task 2: a released file still recorded in the quarantine, which alert_steps() writes daily, and an admin's release
  // of sealed images, which staffAlert writes after the release's commit.
  | "release_undestroyed"
  | "seal_released"
  // 3d Task 3: the edge's job gave up on purges, which it writes as its own row of the outbox.
  | "edge_purge_failed"
  // 3d Task 5: the transparency job published a day's value without an outside timestamp, or found the day before
  // without a published value, each written as the job's own row of the outbox.
  | "head_unwitnessed"
  | "head_missed"
  // 3d Task 6: an author asked for a person, and a cap or a limit refused a program's measure, each written by staffAlert
  // after its commit; a request for a person waited longer than its target, the automated sweep's own row.
  | "automated_objection"
  | "automation_capped"
  | "automated_waiting"
  // 3d Task 7: the comparison of uploads needs the operator (alert_steps() daily, and staffAlert at once over the limit on
  // refusals), and a held upload's hold ended without a report (staffAlert after the end's commit).
  | "matcher_down"
  | "hold_ended_unreported"
  // 3d review M13: a day's value whose keeper's mail never went out, the transparency job's own row in the next day's
  // first round.
  | "head_unmailed"
  // 3b Task 5: imported images whose match does not act were left out of their import, which staffAlert writes after the
  // feeder's settling commit.
  | "import_image_flagged";
export interface StaffAlertMessage {
  template: StaffAlertKind;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

/**
 * A staff alert's template data: every member as the text the template prints. A 3f alert's facts go as they are, each
 * count as its digits, with the time it is sent: the template prints a time with its day only when that is not today's.
 */
function staffData(message: StaffMessage, now: Date): Record<string, string> {
  switch (message.template) {
    case "contact_mail":
    case "contact_mail_escalated":
    case "order_due":
    case "mailbox_unreachable":
    case "alert_channel_down":
    case "order_opened":
    case "order_corrected":
    case "order_unverified":
    case "order_effected":
    case "order_reinstated":
    case "hold_ending":
    case "copy_overdue":
    case "copy_taken":
    case "report_owed":
    case "handover_undestroyed":
    case "quarantine_due":
    case "quarantine_lost":
    case "release_undestroyed":
    case "seal_released":
    case "edge_purge_failed":
    case "head_unwitnessed":
    case "head_missed":
    case "automated_objection":
    case "automation_capped":
    case "automated_waiting":
    case "matcher_down":
    case "hold_ended_unreported":
    case "head_unmailed":
    case "import_image_flagged":
      return { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(message.facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, String(value)])), now: now.toISOString() };
    case "moderation_urgent":
      return {
        count: String(message.count),
        ...(message.oldest === null ? {} : { oldest: noticeTime(message.oldest) }),
        phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off",
        ...(message.heldUploads ? { heldUploads: String(message.heldUploads) } : {}),
      };
    case "moderation_waiting": {
      // A lane's pair only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      const data: Record<string, string> = { phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off" };
      for (const lane of message.lanes) {
        if (lane.count <= 0) continue;
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Count`] = String(lane.count);
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Oldest`] = noticeTime(lane.oldest);
      }
      if (message.interim > 0) data.interimCount = String(message.interim);
      // 3e Task 4: the replies unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, only when there are any.
      if (message.replies && message.replies.count > 0) {
        data.replyCount = String(message.replies.count);
        data.replyOldest = noticeTime(message.replies.oldest);
      }
      return data;
    }
    case "moderation_burst":
      return { handle: message.handle, count: String(message.count) };
    case "moderation_csam_lifted":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), what: message.what, ...(message.matched ? { matched: "yes" } : {}) };
    case "moderation_reads":
      return { handle: message.handle, limit: String(message.limit) };
    case "moderation_reveal":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), count: String(message.count), limit: String(message.limit) };
  }
}

export type NotifierMailResult = "sent" | "folded" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused";
export type AccountMailResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "refused";

/** What staff may know of a signed-out notifier without a reveal: never the name or the address themselves. */
export interface NotifierFacts {
  /** False for an id no contact has: it was never stored, or the janitor has forgotten it. Then the other four are false too. */
  found: boolean;
  named: boolean;
  contactGiven: boolean;
  confirmed: boolean;
  suppressed: boolean;
}

/** A contact's ciphertexts open under the key, or under a key it replaced. Nothing read is ever written back under the newer key. */
const open = (deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "config">, payload: string): string => decrypt(payload, [deps.config.notifierKey, ...deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys]).toString("utf8");
const seal = (deps: AuthDeps, plain: string): string => encrypt(Buffer.from(plain, "utf8"), deps.config.notifierKey);

/** The same day `months` calendar months later in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes that month's last day. */
function monthsLater(at: Date, months: number): Date {
  const month = at.getUTCMonth() + months;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month, Math.min(at.getUTCDate(), lastDay), at.getUTCHours(), at.getUTCMinutes(), at.getUTCSeconds(), at.getUTCMilliseconds()));
}

/** The cap's marker for an address, by its keyed hash: set when a receipt goes to it unconfirmed, gone a day later. */
const receiptCapKey = (hash: string) => `notifier-receipt:${hash}`;

/** The receipt's template data. The page link is this module's: the status page's address with the contact's mail token in the fragment, which no server log sees. */
function receiptData(deps: AuthDeps, message: NoticeReceivedMessage, pageUrl?: string): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ref: message.ref,
    time: noticeTime(message.receivedAt),
    items: message.items.join(", "),
    ...(pageUrl === undefined ? {} : { pageUrl }),
    termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms`,
  };
}

/** Sends one mail. "refused" when the relay refused the recipient for good; any other failure is thrown, for the caller to try again. */
async function deliver(deps: AuthDeps, message: MailMessage): Promise<"sent" | "refused"> {
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send(message);
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof MailRefused) return "refused";
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Stores a signed-out notifier's contact under the id the moderation module wrote on the notice: the name and the
 * address normalised and encrypted under the notifier key, the address's keyed hash for the cap and for stops, and, with
 * an address, a fresh mail token encrypted beside it. A disposable address is taken: a notifier may want one. The contact
 * is forgotten 13 months on unless the notice is still owed something by then.
 */
export async function storeNotifierContact(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, contact: { name?: string; email?: string }): Promise<void> {
  const name = contact.name?.trim() || null;
  const email = contact.email?.trim().toLowerCase() || null;
  await deps.repo.createNotifierContact({
    id: contactId,
    nameEnc: name === null ? null : seal(deps, name),
    emailEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, email),
    emailHash: email === null ? null : emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email),
    // The token of the mails' link: it alone confirms or stops the address, so whoever typed someone else's address cannot.
    mailTokenEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, randomToken()),
    forgetAfter: monthsLater(deps.now(), RETENTION.contactMaxMonths),
  });
}

/**
 * Sends a signed-out notifier's receipt, under three rules. A stopped address gets nothing ("suppressed"). An address
 * that is not confirmed gets one receipt in 24 hours, and a further one is "folded": it rides in the next daily mail, so
 * typing someone's address into the form many times sends them one mail. A confirmed address has no cap. "forgotten"
 * when no contact has the id, "no_address" when the contact left none. A failure of the relay that is not about the
 * address is thrown, and gives the day's one receipt back first, so the retry is sent rather than folded.
 */
export async function mailNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, message: NotifierMessage): Promise<NotifierMailResult> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact) return "forgotten";
  if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) return "no_address";
  const hash = contact.emailHash;
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  // Opened before the cap is taken: a ciphertext no configured key opens throws here and spends nothing.
  const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
  const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${message.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
  const confirmed = (await deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes([hash], deps.now())).has(hash);
  if (!confirmed && !(await deps.kv.setIfAbsent(receiptCapKey(hash), "1", RECEIPT_CAP_MS))) return "folded";
  try {
    return await deliver(deps, { to, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message, pageUrl) });
  } catch (err) {
    if (!confirmed) await deps.kv.del(receiptCapKey(hash)).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "notifier receipt: the day's one receipt could not be given back after a failed send"));
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a mail to an account's own address, which its sign-in code confirmed: no cap and no confirmation. A stop of
 * that address applies to the two report mails, the receipt and the daily update, and never to a statement of reasons.
 * The update of an account is signed in: it carries its lines and neither a receipt nor a page link, since an account
 * follows its reports in the app. "no_address" for an account that is deleted or was never there.
 */
export async function mailAccount(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string, message: AccountMessage): Promise<AccountMailResult> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return "no_address";
  if (isDecisionMessage(message)) {
    // A statement is never held back by a stop of the address.
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: decisionData(message) });
  }
  // 3d: nor is the notice of a lost image, which is about the account's own post and not about its reports.
  if (message.template === "image_lost") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "image_lost", data: { createdAt: noticeTime(message.postCreatedAt) } });
  // 3d Task 2: nor is the notice of a release. Its paragraphs are rendered from these flat members by the template, from
  // the same function as the app's notice screen; the times go as ISO text and are printed as korbat's mails print them.
  if (message.template === "release_notice") {
    const view = message.view;
    return deliver(deps, {
      to: user.email,
      template: "release_notice",
      data: {
        basis: view.basis,
        releasedAt: view.releasedAt,
        backupsClearAt: view.backupsClearAt,
        upload: view.upload ? "yes" : "no",
        postCount: String(view.postCount),
        images: String(view.images),
        createdAt: view.posts[0]?.createdAt ?? "",
        appeal: view.appeal,
      },
    });
  }
  // 3d Task 7: nor are the notices of a refused upload, one paragraph per line, as the app's screen renders them.
  if (message.template === "upload_refused" || message.template === "upload_hold_lifted") {
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: { notice: message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK) } });
  }
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  if (message.template === "notice_update") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [...message.lines], receipts: [], pages: [] } });
  return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message as NoticeReceivedMessage) });
}

/**
 * The daily update to signed-out notifiers (3c design, sections 5 and 7.8): the parts are grouped by their contacts'
 * address, which only this module can see, and each address gets one notice_update with every part's lines, every
 * carried receipt with its page link, and the page link of each other notice it has a line for. A page link is the
 * status page's address with that contact's own mail token in the fragment, the same link its receipt carried.
 *
 * It applies a stop of the address, and neither the confirmation nor the 24-hour cap: nothing is withheld for want of a
 * confirmed address. It answers for each contact, and throws for none: an address whose mail the relay could not take is
 * "unavailable", so its lines stay pending while every other address's update is still sent. Each contact is read in a
 * try of its own: one that cannot be read (a ciphertext no configured key opens) is logged with its id, never an
 * address, and answered "unavailable" too.
 */
export async function mailNotifierUpdates(deps: AuthDeps, parts: readonly NotifierUpdatePart[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>> {
  const results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
  /** The readable parts, by their address's keyed hash, in the order given. */
  const byAddress = new Map<string, { to: string; parts: { part: NotifierUpdatePart; pageUrl: string }[] }>();
  for (const part of parts) {
    try {
      const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(part.contactId);
      if (!contact) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "forgotten");
        continue;
      }
      if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "no_address");
        continue;
      }
      if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([contact.emailHash])).has(contact.emailHash)) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "suppressed");
        continue;
      }
      const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
      const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${part.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
      const group = byAddress.get(contact.emailHash) ?? { to, parts: [] };
      group.parts.push({ part, pageUrl });
      byAddress.set(contact.emailHash, group);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, contactId: part.contactId }, "notifier update: the contact could not be read; its lines stay pending");
      results.set(part.contactId, "unavailable");
    }
  }
  for (const group of byAddress.values()) {
    const receipts = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt ? [{ ref: part.receipt.ref, time: noticeTime(part.receipt.receivedAt), items: part.receipt.items.join(", "), pageUrl }] : []));
    // A notice whose receipt rides in this update has its page with the receipt; every other notice with a line gets a page paragraph.
    const pages = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt || part.lines.length === 0 ? [] : [{ ref: part.ref, pageUrl }]));
    const lines = group.parts.flatMap(({ part }) => [...part.lines]);
    let result: NotifierUpdateResult;
    try {
      result = await deliver(deps, {
        to: group.to,
        template: "notice_update",
        data: { signedIn: false, lines, receipts, pages, ...(receipts.length > 0 ? { termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms` } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // The relay could not take this address's mail: the other addresses' mails still go. The contacts' ids, never the address.
      deps.log.warn({ err, contactIds: group.parts.map(({ part }) => part.contactId) }, "notifier update: not sent; its lines stay pending for the next round");
      result = "unavailable";
    }
    for (const { part } of group.parts) results.set(part.contactId, result);
  }
  // In the order the parts were given, whatever order the addresses were mailed in.
  return new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.contactId, results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"]));
}

/**
 * Sends a staff alert to every live staff account's address, best effort: a failed send is logged and never thrown, and
 * the answer is the number of addresses the relay took, 0 when it took none or there is no live staff account. It
 * applies no throttle: the moderation module keeps every throttle, as a key in the shared limit store.
 */
export async function mailStaff(deps: AuthDeps, message: StaffMessage): Promise<number> {
  const data = staffData(message, deps.now());
  let addresses: string[];
  try {
    addresses = await deps.repo.liveStaffAddresses();
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert: the staff accounts could not be read");
    return 0;
  }
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const to of addresses) {
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to, template: message.template, data });
      accepted++;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert email failed");
    }
  }
  return accepted;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 5 (design, sections 5, 7.7 and 18, W.8): the audit head's daily mail to the keeper, the copy that is not on
 * korbat's server: the day, the value, the place and the hash, from which the keeper computes the value again, and whether
 * an outside timestamp is stored. Typed like every message, so no caller passes free text.
 */
export interface KeeperMessage {
  template: "head_published";
  day: string;
  value: string;
  seq: number;
  hash: string;
  witnessed: boolean;
}

/** What became of the keeper's mail: sent, not sent while HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL is empty, refused by the relay, or failed. */
export type KeeperMailResult = "sent" | "off" | "refused" | "failed";

/**
 * Sends the keeper's daily mail to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL and to nobody else: the caller names no address, and none is read from
 * an account or a staff list. While the setting is empty it sends nothing ("off"). A failure is logged, without the
 * address, and answered, never thrown: the day's value stands published either way. 3d review M13: the transparency job
 * records a mail the relay accepted and sends one that failed again in the day's later rounds.
 */
export async function mailKeeper(deps: AuthDeps, message: KeeperMessage): Promise<KeeperMailResult> {
  const to = deps.config.keeperMail;
  if (to === null) return "off";
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send({
      to,
      template: "head_published",
      data: { day: message.day, value: message.value, seq: String(message.seq), hash: message.hash, witnessed: message.witnessed ? "stored" : "none" },
    });
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: "head_published", day: message.day }, "keeper's mail: not sent");
    return err instanceof MailRefused ? "refused" : "failed";
  }
}

/** For each id: whether a contact has it, whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped now. */
export async function notifierFacts(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierFacts>> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactFacts(contactIds);
  const hashes = rows.flatMap((row) => (row.emailHash === null ? [] : [row.emailHash]));
  const [confirmed, suppressed] = await Promise.all([deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes(hashes, deps.now()), deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes(hashes)]);
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  return new Map(
    contactIds.map((id): [string, NotifierFacts] => {
      const row = byId.get(id);
      if (!row) return [id, { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }];
      return [id, { found: true, named: row.named, contactGiven: row.contactGiven, confirmed: row.emailHash !== null && confirmed.has(row.emailHash), suppressed: row.emailHash !== null && suppressed.has(row.emailHash) }];
    }),
  );
}

/** The name a notifier gave, or null: for a confirmed reveal only. The address is never handed out. */
export async function notifierName(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  return contact?.nameEnc ? open(deps, contact.nameEnc) : null;
}

/** The contact's address hash when the token is its mail token, compared in constant time; null for anything else. */
async function addressOfToken(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact?.mailTokenEnc || !contact.emailHash) return null;
  let mailToken: string;
  try {
    mailToken = open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc);
  } catch (err) {
    // A contact no configured key opens matches nothing; the fault is the operator's to see, with the contact's id and no address.
    deps.log.error({ err, contactId }, "notifier contact: its mail token could not be decrypted");
    return null;
  }
  return safeEqual(mailToken, token) ? contact.emailHash : null;
}

/** Whether the token is the contact's mail token; false when the contact has none. */
export async function notifierMailTokenMatches(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token)) !== null;
}

/**
 * "I sent this": with the contact's mail token, records the address as confirmed for 30 days and lifts any stop of it.
 * False, and nothing done, for any other token: typing someone's address proves nothing about it.
 */
export async function confirmNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  const now = deps.now();
  await deps.repo.confirmNotifierAddress(hash, now, new Date(now.getTime() + RETENTION.confirmationDays * DAY));
  return true;
}

/** "Stop": with the contact's mail token, korbat sends this address no more mails about reports. Its notices are still processed. */
export async function stopNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  await deps.repo.suppressNotifierAddress(hash);
  return true;
}

/** Whether the account's address asked korbat to stop its report mails. */
export async function accountReportMailStopped(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  return (await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash);
}

/** Lifts a stop of the account's address, for the account's own Settings: the session proves the address. True when there was one. */
export async function resumeAccountReportMail(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  return deps.repo.liftNotifierSuppression(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email));
}

/** Moves the day these contacts are forgotten. */
export function forgetNotifierAfter(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[], at: Date): Promise<void> {
  return deps.repo.setNotifierForgetAfter(contactIds, at);
}

/** The contacts that gave this address, with the names they gave: for an access request from a signed-out notifier, from the command line only. */
export async function findNotifierContacts(deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "repo" | "config">, email: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactsByEmailHash(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email));
  return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, name: row.nameEnc ? open(deps, row.nameEnc) : null }));
}

/** How many contacts and confirmations the janitor should have removed more than a day ago: a count only, for the console's overview. */
export function overdueContacts(deps: AuthDeps): Promise<number> {
  return deps.repo.countNotifierRowsDue(new Date(deps.now().getTime() - DAY));
}
```

```ts
import type { ImportErrorCode, ImportSource } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**

export type ImportErrorStatus = 400 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 413 | 429 | 503;

  import_active: 409,
  rate_limited: 429,
  import_weekly_limit: 429,
  archive_too_large: 413,
  wrong_state: 409,
  wrong_offset: 409,
  chunk_too_large: 413,
  chunk_mismatch: 400,
  not_an_archive: 400,
  statement_required: 400,
  nothing_chosen: 400,
  import_too_soon: 403,
  account_suspended: 403,
  not_found: 404,
  invalid_request: 400,
};

/** 9.4's and 10.9's sentences; the app shows its own words module's, and these are what a log or a curl reads. */
const MESSAGES: Record<ImportErrorKind, string> = {
  imports_unavailable: "Imports are paused for now. Try again later.",
  import_active: "You already have an import in progress.",
  rate_limited: "Many imports were started from your network today. Try again tomorrow.",
  import_weekly_limit: "You have published three imports this week. Try again later.",
  archive_too_large: "Archives can be at most 2 GB.",
  wrong_state: "This import has moved on. Reload to see where it is.",
  wrong_offset: "That part of the archive is not the next one.",
  chunk_too_large: "That part of the archive is too large.",
  chunk_mismatch: "That part of the archive arrived damaged. Send it again.",
  not_an_archive: "This file is not an archive of that source.",
  statement_required: "Confirm that these are your own posts.",
  nothing_chosen: "Your choice leaves no posts to publish.",
  import_too_soon: "You can import posts once your account is 7 days old.",
  account_suspended: "Your account is suspended, so you cannot do this now.",
  not_found: "Not found.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
};

/** An expected, user-facing failure. The HTTP layer turns it into an ErrorEnvelope with this code and its status. */
export class ImportError extends Error {
  readonly status: ImportErrorStatus;
  readonly retryAfterSeconds: number | undefined;
  readonly details: unknown;
  constructor(
    readonly code: ImportErrorKind,
    options: {
      /** For rate_limited and import_weekly_limit: the response carries Retry-After. */
      retryAfterSeconds?: number;
      /** For wrong_offset: `{ receivedBytes }`, so a retry learns where to go on (7.3). */
      details?: unknown;
      message?: string;
    } = {},
  ) {
    super(options.message ?? MESSAGES[code]);
    this.name = "ImportError";
    this.status = STATUS[code];
    this.retryAfterSeconds = options.retryAfterSeconds;
    this.details = options.details;
  }
}

/** The owner's settings of section 7.7, as config.ts has read and checked them. */
export interface ImportSettings {
  /** IMPORTS: off refuses every new import; running imports finish. */
  imports: boolean;
  /** IMPORT_IMAGES: whether a new import brings images; the configuration refuses it on while no matcher is (decision 15). */
  images: boolean;
  /** IMPORT_SOURCES: the sources a new import may name (decision 16). */
  sources: readonly ImportSource[];
  /** IMPORT_MAX_ACTIVE: imports in uploading or scanning on the site at once. */
  maxActive: number;
  /** IMPORT_IMAGES_PER_HOUR: the feeder's pace, counted in the limit store under import-images-site (7.4). */
  imagesPerHour: number;
  /** IMPORT_MIN_FREE_BYTES: kept free on import-archives beyond a new import's size and the most a scan may write. */

export interface ImportDeps {

  social: SocialForImports;

  media: MediaForImports;
  /** 3b Task 5: the moderation module's interface: the alert for images left out as flagged (8.1). */
  moderation: ModerationForImports;
  /** 3b Task 5: the profile store's read of whether an account's suspension runs, which refuses a confirmation (8.5). */
  profiles: Pick<ProfileStore, "suspended">;
  limits: RateLimitStore;
  settings: ImportSettings;
  log: Logger;
  now: () => Date;
  /** IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes; tests only give a smaller one, so a chunk's rules are tried on a few bytes. */
  chunkBytes: number;
  /**
   * The uploads that have a chunk on its way into archive.part in this process: a second chunk of the same import waits
   * for nothing and is answered wrong_offset, so two writers never append to one file. The API runs as one instance.
   */
  inFlight: Set<string>;
  /**
   * 3b Task 5: the feeder's plans (7.4), one for each import that prepares, built once a process from posts.jsonl and kept
   * until the import leaves preparing: the preview's pages are gone once it is confirmed, and the plan finds image N of the
   * cursor without reading the work file again.
   */
  plans: Map<string, ImportPlan>;
}

/**
 * Counts one action of the account in every window social/tiers.ts gives it (7.6: import-chunk, import-act,
 * import-pick, at any age) and refuses it once one is full, with Retry-After. A store that cannot count refuses the
 * action as imports_unavailable (9.4: the limit store), as every limit of korbat fails closed.
 */
export async function enforceImportLimit(deps: Pick<ImportDeps, "limits">, action: ImportAction, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  for (const limit of limitsFor(action, 0)) {
    let hit: { count: number; resetMs: number };
    try {
      hit = await deps.limits.hit(`imports:${limit.bucket}:${userId}`, limit.windowMs);
    } catch {
      throw new ImportError("imports_unavailable");
    }
    if (hit.count > limit.max) throw new ImportError("rate_limited", { retryAfterSeconds: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hit.resetMs / 1000)), message: "Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again." });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { IMPORT_RULES, type ImportFailure } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { createJob, type JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import type { ImportDeps } from "./context";
import { feedRound } from "./feeder";
import { endFiles } from "./flows/end";
import { runIntake, type IntakeCaps } from "./intake";

/**
 * The job import-drive (3b design, section 7.5): every five seconds, under the shared job lock, one round that moves the
 * imports along. A round is a plain function of the clock, so tests run it with any time, and each step is safe to
 * repeat. Task 4 builds steps 1 to 3 (scans done, the intake, the time limits of 4.8, each one statement), 7 (retention)
 * and 8 (orphans, every tenth round); Task 5 step 4 (feeding, feeder.ts) and the leftovers of 7.4; publishing and undoing
 * are Task 6's. A round never holds a lock across rounds, and a failure of one import's step is logged and passes on to
 * the next.
 */

export interface DriveReport {
  /** Scans whose summary the round read: moved to ready, or to failed. */
  ready: number;
  failed: number;
  /** The bounds of 4.8. */
  expiredUploads: number;
  timedOutScans: number;
  expiredPreviews: number;
  stoppedLate: number;
  /** Step 4 (Task 5): images fed, left out before a row, settled as left out and among them flagged; a refusal's stop; the move to publishing. */
  fed: number;
  skipped: number;
  leftOut: number;
  flagged: number;
  refused: number;
  publishing: number;
  /** 7.4: rows on no post of imports that have ended, deleted. */
  leftovers: number;
  /** Step 7. */
  picksDeleted: number;
  rowsDeleted: number;
  /** Step 8: archive folders and markers deleted, work folders asked for, requests withdrawn. */
  orphanArchives: number;
  orphanWork: number;
  withdrawn: number;
}

/** States whose import still needs its work folder: the scan writes it, the preview and the later steps read it. */
const NEEDS_WORK = new Set(["scanning", "ready", "preparing", "publishing"]);
/** States whose import still needs its archive: the upload writes it, the scan reads it. */
const NEEDS_ARCHIVE = new Set(["uploading", "scanning"]);

/** Tests only: the intake's caps. */
export interface DriveOptions {
  orphans: boolean;
  caps?: Partial<IntakeCaps>;
}

/** Steps 1 and 2: each import in scanning whose importer has written its summary. */
async function scansDone(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date, report: DriveReport, caps: Partial<IntakeCaps> | undefined): Promise<void> {
  for (const job of await deps.repo.scanning()) {
    try {
      const summary = await deps.files.readSummary(job.id);
      // No summary yet: the importer has not finished, or not started.
      if (!summary.ok && summary.code === "missing") continue;
      // The archive is read once the summary is: it goes at once, with its marker (decision 4).
      await deps.files.removeArchive(job.id);
      let failure: ImportFailure | null = null;
      if (!summary.ok) {
        // A summary the API cannot take (not JSON, not the contract, another import's, a link): the scan is unreadable.
        deps.log.error({ id: job.id, code: summary.code }, "import: the scan's summary was refused");
        failure = "unreadable";
      } else if (summary.value.status === "failed") {
        failure = summary.value.failure;
      } else {
        const young = now.getTime() - job.ownerCreatedAt.getTime() < IMPORT_RULES.newAccountDays * 86_400_000;
        const intake = await runIntake({
          id: job.id,
          summary: summary.value,
          images: job.images,
          createdAt: job.createdAt,
          young,
          known: (keys) => deps.social.importedKeys(job.ownerId, keys),
          files: deps.files,
          log: deps.log,
          caps,
        });
        if (intake.ok) {
          if (await deps.repo.toReady(job.id, intake.scan, now)) report.ready++;
          continue;
        }
        deps.log.error({ id: job.id, code: intake.code }, "import: posts.jsonl was refused");
        failure = "unreadable";
      }
      if (await deps.repo.failScan(job.id, failure, now)) {
        report.failed++;
        deps.log.info({ id: job.id, phase: "failed", failure }, "import: the scan failed");
      }
      // A failed scan's work folder is of no use; the importer writes none for most failures, and deletes what is there.
      await deps.files.requestWorkDeletion(job.id);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ id: job.id, err }, "import: a scan's end could not be handled; the next round tries again");
    }
  }
}

/** Step 3: the bounds of 4.8, each one statement, and then the files of what they ended. */
async function timeLimits(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date, report: DriveReport): Promise<void> {
  const uploads = await deps.repo.expireUploads(now);
  const scans = await deps.repo.timeOutScans(now);
  const previews = await deps.repo.expirePreviews(now);
  const late = await deps.repo.stopTimedOut(now);
  report.expiredUploads = uploads.length;
  report.timedOutScans = scans.length;
  report.expiredPreviews = previews.length;
  report.stoppedLate = late.length;
  for (const id of [...uploads, ...scans, ...previews, ...late]) await endFiles(deps, id);
  if (uploads.length + scans.length + previews.length + late.length > 0) {
    deps.log.info({ expiredUploads: uploads.length, timedOutScans: scans.length, expiredPreviews: previews.length, stoppedLate: late.length }, "import-drive: time limits");
  }
}

/** Step 4: the feeder of 7.4 for the import in preparing confirmed longest ago. */
async function feeding(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date, report: DriveReport): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const fed = await feedRound(deps, now);
    if (fed === null) return;
    report.fed = fed.fed;
    report.skipped = fed.skipped;
    report.leftOut = fed.leftOut;
    report.flagged = fed.flagged;
    report.refused = fed.refused ? 1 : 0;
    report.publishing = fed.published ? 1 : 0;
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err }, "import: the feeder's round failed; the next round tries again");
  }
}

/**
 * 7.4: every import that has left preparing and publishing (stopped by its author, a refusal, a time limit or an admin,
 * done, undone) and still has image rows on no post, each round and not once on the move: the rows go in a transaction
 * of their own through the media module, which notes their files as owed, and their files are asked for after the
 * commit. A row a refusal holds stays (the keep trigger), and is not asked about while its hold stands.
 */
async function leftovers(deps: ImportDeps, report: DriveReport): Promise<void> {
  const ids = await deps.media.importsWithLeftovers();
  if (ids.length === 0) return;
  const statuses = await deps.repo.statuses(ids);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const status = statuses.get(id);
    if (status === undefined || status === "preparing" || status === "publishing") continue;
    try {
      const gone = await deps.repo.transaction((tx) => deps.media.deleteImportLeftovers(tx, id));
      await deps.media.releaseFiles(gone);
      report.leftovers += gone.length;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ id, err }, "import: an ended import's images could not be deleted; the next round tries again");
    }
  }
  if (report.leftovers > 0) deps.log.info({ leftovers: report.leftovers }, "import-drive: images of ended imports deleted");
}

/**
 * Step 8: what a crash between a commit and a file operation left behind, once older than an hour. An archive folder or
 * a queue marker goes unless its import is still uploading or scanning; a work folder is asked for unless its import
 * still needs it; a deletion request is withdrawn once the importer has carried it out and an hour has passed, so a scan
 * that was aborted has long seen it.
 */
async function orphans(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date, report: DriveReport): Promise<void> {
  const at = now.getTime();
  const old = (entries: { id: string; ageMs: number }[]) => entries.filter((entry) => entry.ageMs > IMPORT_RULES.orphanAgeMs);
  const folders = old(await deps.files.archiveFolders(at));
  const markers = old(await deps.files.queueMarkers(at));
  const work = old(await deps.files.workFolders(at));
  const requests = await deps.files.deletionRequests(at);
  const statuses = await deps.repo.statuses([...new Set([...folders, ...markers, ...work].map((entry) => entry.id))]);
  for (const id of new Set([...folders, ...markers].map((entry) => entry.id))) {
    const status = statuses.get(id);
    if (status !== undefined && NEEDS_ARCHIVE.has(status)) continue;
    await deps.files.removeArchive(id);
    report.orphanArchives++;
  }
  const requested = new Set(requests.map((entry) => entry.id));
  for (const { id } of work) {
    const status = statuses.get(id);
    if ((status !== undefined && NEEDS_WORK.has(status)) || requested.has(id)) continue;
    await deps.files.requestWorkDeletion(id);
    report.orphanWork++;
  }
  for (const { id, ageMs } of requests) {
    if (ageMs <= IMPORT_RULES.orphanAgeMs || (await deps.files.workFolderPresent(id))) continue;
    await deps.files.withdrawWorkDeletion(id);
    report.withdrawn++;
  }
  if (report.orphanArchives + report.orphanWork + report.withdrawn > 0) {
    deps.log.warn({ archives: report.orphanArchives, work: report.orphanWork, withdrawn: report.withdrawn }, "import-drive: orphans");
  }
}

/** One round at `now`. */
export async function driveRound(deps: ImportDeps, now: Date, options: DriveOptions): Promise<DriveReport> {
  const report: DriveReport = {
    ready: 0,
    failed: 0,
    expiredUploads: 0,
    timedOutScans: 0,
    expiredPreviews: 0,
    stoppedLate: 0,
    fed: 0,
    skipped: 0,
    leftOut: 0,
    flagged: 0,
    refused: 0,
    publishing: 0,
    leftovers: 0,
    picksDeleted: 0,
    rowsDeleted: 0,
    orphanArchives: 0,
    orphanWork: 0,
    withdrawn: 0,
  };
  await scansDone(deps, now, report, options.caps);
  await timeLimits(deps, now, report);
  await feeding(deps, now, report);
  await leftovers(deps, report);
  const kept = await deps.repo.retention(now);
  report.picksDeleted = kept.picks;
  report.rowsDeleted = kept.rows;
  if (options.orphans) await orphans(deps, now, report);
  return report;
}

/** import-drive as a job: rounds every driveIntervalMs, the lock held for at most driveLockMs past a crash, orphans every tenth round. */
export function createDriveJob(deps: ImportDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  let rounds = 0;
  const job = createJob({
    name: "import-drive",
    intervalMs: IMPORT_RULES.driveIntervalMs,
    lockTtlMs: IMPORT_RULES.driveLockMs,
    lock,
    log: deps.log,
    run: async () => {
      rounds++;
      await driveRound(deps, deps.now(), { orphans: rounds % IMPORT_RULES.orphanEveryRounds === 1 });
    },
  });
  return { round: job.round, start: job.start };
}
```

```ts
import type { ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { enforceImportLimit, ImportError, type ImportDeps } from "../context";
import { importView } from "../view";

/**
 * The files of an import that has ended before its posts were chosen, or whose scan the drive has read (3b design,
 * sections 4.8, 6.6 and 7.5): its archive folder and queue marker go at once, and the importer is asked to delete its
 * work folder and to stop scanning it (delete/<id>, which the drive withdraws once it is carried out). Each step is safe
 * to repeat and leaves nothing to undo.
 */
export async function endFiles(deps: Pick<ImportDeps, "files">, id: string): Promise<void> {
  await deps.files.removeArchive(id);
  await deps.files.requestWorkDeletion(id);
}

/**
 * POST /api/imports/:id/cancel (9.2): the person's cancel while the archive uploads, waits for its scan or is previewed;
 * counted in import-act. A suspended account may cancel: it only ends and deletes (8.5).
 */
export async function cancelImport(deps: ImportDeps, ownerId: string, id: string): Promise<ImportView> {
  await enforceImportLimit(deps, "import-act", ownerId);
  if (!(await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId))) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  if (!(await deps.repo.cancel(id, ownerId))) throw new ImportError("wrong_state");
  await endFiles(deps, id);
  deps.log.info({ id, phase: "cancelled" }, "import: cancelled");
  const row = await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId);
  if (!row) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  return importView(deps, row);
}

/**
 * POST /api/imports/:id/stop (3b design, sections 4.6 and 9.2): the person's Stop while the import prepares or publishes,
 * counted in import-act, at once and in one UPDATE (stopped, by_author, the seed cleared, ended_at). Published posts stay;
 * the images prepared and on no post go in import-drive's next round (7.4, the leftovers), and the work folder is asked
 * for here, so what was not published goes unopened. A suspended account may stop: it only ends (8.5).
 */
export async function stopImport(deps: ImportDeps, ownerId: string, id: string): Promise<ImportView> {
  await enforceImportLimit(deps, "import-act", ownerId);
  if (!(await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId))) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  if (!(await deps.repo.stop(id, ownerId))) throw new ImportError("wrong_state");
  deps.plans.delete(id);
  await endFiles(deps, id);
  deps.log.info({ id, phase: "stopped", reason: "by_author" }, "import: stopped");
  const row = await deps.repo.find(id, ownerId);
  if (!row) throw new ImportError("not_found");
  return importView(deps, row);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The only file outside `src/imports/` may import. Everything else in the module is private and the architecture test
 * fails the build if another file reaches into it (3b design, section 9.1).
 */
import type { MiddlewareHandler } from "hono";
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { IMPORT_RULES, type ImportSource } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForImports, ProfileStore } from "../auth";
import type { Config } from "../config";
import type { AppEnv } from "../env";
import type { JobLock } from "../lib/jobs";
import type { MediaForImports } from "../media";
import type { RateLimitStore } from "../middleware/rate-limit";
import type { ModerationForImports } from "../moderation";
import type { SocialForImports } from "../social";
import type { ImportDeps, ImportSettings } from "./context";
import { createDriveJob, driveRound, type DriveOptions } from "./drive";
import { createImportFiles } from "./files";
import { createImportRepo } from "./repo";
import { importRoutes } from "./routes";

export { ImportError } from "./context";
export type { ImportDeps, ImportErrorKind, ImportSettings } from "./context";
export type { DriveReport } from "./drive";
export type { FeedReport } from "./feeder";
export type { ImportList } from "./routes";

/** The owner's settings of section 7.7, as config.ts read and checked them. */
export function importSettingsFrom(config: Pick<Config, "IMPORTS" | "IMPORT_IMAGES" | "IMPORT_SOURCES" | "IMPORT_MAX_ACTIVE" | "IMPORT_IMAGES_PER_HOUR" | "IMPORT_MIN_FREE_BYTES">): ImportSettings {
  return {
    imports: config.IMPORTS === "on",
    images: config.IMPORT_IMAGES === "on",
    sources: config.IMPORT_SOURCES as readonly ImportSource[],
    maxActive: config.IMPORT_MAX_ACTIVE,
    imagesPerHour: config.IMPORT_IMAGES_PER_HOUR,
    minFreeBytes: config.IMPORT_MIN_FREE_BYTES,
  };
}

export interface CreateImportsOptions {
  /** The korbat_api pool. The module never sees the auth pool. */
  apiDb: Db;
  /** import-archives, which the API writes and the importer only reads, and import-work, which the API only reads. */
  archivesDir: string;
  workDir: string;
  settings: ImportSettings;
  /** The auth module's interface: whether an account's address is verified (4.2 step 3). */
  auth: AuthForImports;
  /** The social module's interface: which lines the account already imported (7.5 step 2). */
  social: SocialForImports;
  /** 3b Task 5: the media module's interface, through which imported images enter its pipeline (7.4, 8.2). */
  media: MediaForImports;
  /** 3b Task 5: the moderation module's interface, which alerts staff to images left out as flagged (8.1). */
  moderation: ModerationForImports;
  /** 3b Task 5: the profile store, whose read of a running suspension refuses a confirmation (8.5). */
  profiles: Pick<ProfileStore, "suspended">;
  /** The store every limit counts in. */
  rateLimitStore: RateLimitStore;
  /** The auth module's requireSession: an onboarded account with CSRF and Origin checked. */
  requireSession: MiddlewareHandler<AppEnv>;
  logger: Logger;
  now?: () => Date;
  /** Tests only: the free space of import-archives, openWorkFile's device, and a smaller chunk. */
  freeBytes?: () => Promise<number>;
  workDevice?: number;
  chunkBytes?: number;
}

export function createImports(options: CreateImportsOptions) {
  const deps: ImportDeps = {
    repo: createImportRepo(options.apiDb),
    files: createImportFiles({ archivesDir: options.archivesDir, workDir: options.workDir, log: options.logger, freeBytes: options.freeBytes, workDevice: options.workDevice }),
    auth: options.auth,
    social: options.social,
    media: options.media,
    moderation: options.moderation,
    profiles: options.profiles,
    limits: options.rateLimitStore,
    settings: options.settings,
    log: options.logger,
    now: options.now ?? (() => new Date()),
    chunkBytes: options.chunkBytes ?? IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes,
    inFlight: new Set(),
    plans: new Map(),
  };
  return {
    deps,
    /** Mounted at /api/imports after the session's resolution. */
    routes: importRoutes(deps, options.requireSession),
    /** Creates import-archives' folders. Call once before serving. */
    prepare: () => deps.files.prepare(),
    /** One round of import-drive at the given time. The server runs it on a timer; tests call it directly. */
    drive: (now: Date, driveOptions: DriveOptions) => driveRound(deps, now, driveOptions),
    /** Starts import-drive under the shared job lock, a round every five seconds, and returns the function that stops it. */
    startJobs: (lock: JobLock) => createDriveJob(deps, lock).start(),
  };
}

export type Imports = ReturnType<typeof createImports>;
```

```ts
import { sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { IMPORT_RULES, type ImportChoice, type ImportFailure, type ImportImageSkip, type ImportScanFacts, type ImportSource, type ImportStatus } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { WRITE_CLOCK, closingJudgment, liveNotSuspended } from "../lib/standing";
import { ImportError } from "./context";

/**
 * Every statement on import_jobs, import_picks and import_keys (3b design, sections 6.1 and 9.1), on the korbat_api pool.
 * The triggers of migration 0043 judge each write: import_jobs_insert forces a new import's columns, import_jobs_guard
 * lets each column change only by the move of section 4.1 that names it, and import_picks_guard takes a pick only while
 * its import is ready. Every move below is one UPDATE that names the state it leaves, so a move that lost a race to
 * another (a cancel and the drive, two requests of one upload) changes nothing and is answered as such.
 */

/** The five active states of 4.1, which import_jobs_one_active counts. */
const ACTIVE = sql`('uploading', 'scanning', 'ready', 'preparing', 'publishing')`;
/** The states in which an import has ended for good, or is being removed: its picks are of no further use (7.5 step 7). */
const ENDED = sql`('done', 'stopped', 'undoing', 'undone', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')`;

/** The columns an import's view and its flows read, with bigint and date columns in forms the driver hands over as they are. */
const COLUMNS = sql`j.id, j.owner_id, j.source::text as source, j.status::text as status, j.declared_bytes::float8 as declared_bytes,
  j.received_bytes::float8 as received_bytes, j.created_at, j.uploaded_at, j.scanned_at, j.confirmed_at, j.ended_at, j.failure,
  j.stop_reason, j.staff_rule_id, to_char(j.refused_at_original, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as refused_at_original, j.refused_words, j.scan,
  j.choice, j.posts_published, j.images_kept, j.images_left_out, j.posts_removed, j.images, j.images_left_out_by`;

/**
 * The move out of ready (whichever it is) keeps the counts and fromRef and leaves the month table, the samples, the pages
 * and the count of posts skipped as not public behind (decision 25), as import_jobs_guard requires of it.
 */
const CUT_SCAN = sql`jsonb_set(j.scan || jsonb_build_object('months', '[]'::jsonb, 'samples', '[]'::jsonb, 'pages', '[]'::jsonb),
  '{skipped}', coalesce(j.scan -> 'skipped', '{}'::jsonb) - 'not_public')`;

/**
 * 3b Task 5: images_left_out_by with these counts added, reason by reason (`add` a jsonb object of counts); the guard of
 * 0047 holds every count to growing and their sum to images_left_out, which the same statement raises by as many.
 */
const ADD_BY = (add: SQL): SQL => sql`j.images_left_out_by || (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(a.key, coalesce((j.images_left_out_by ->> a.key)::int, 0) + a.value::int), '{}'::jsonb)
  from jsonb_each_text(${add}) a)`;

/** A fixed key of pg_advisory_xact_lock: every creation takes it, so the site's count of active uploads is read and kept by one at a time (4.2 step 3). */
const SITE_LOCK = sql`hashtext('korbat:import_jobs:site_active')`;

const time = (value: Date | string | null): Date | null => (value === null ? null : new Date(value));

function toRow(raw: RawRow): ImportRow {
  return {
    id: raw.id,
    ownerId: raw.owner_id,
    source: raw.source,
    status: raw.status,
    declaredBytes: Number(raw.declared_bytes),

    refusedWords: raw.refused_words,

/** What the creating statement read, in the order 4.2 step 3 answers its refusals. */
export interface CreateFacts {
  /** The profile row exists, is not deleted and its suspension does not run, by 3e's predicate in the locking statement. */
  live: boolean;
  /** The profile is at least minAccountAgeDays old. */
  aged: boolean;
  /** The account has an import in an active state. */
  active: boolean;
  /** Published imports confirmed in the last seven days, and when the oldest of them leaves the window. */

}

export interface CreateInput {
```
